title: USAF KC-135 Air Refuels RAAF E-7A Wedgetails
description: U.S. Air Force members from the 340th EARS perform aerial refueling to a Royal Australian Air Force E-7A Wedgetail over an undisclosed location. The E-7A Wedgetail can control the tactical battle space, providing direction for fighter aircraft, surface combatants and land based elements, as well as supporting aircraft such as tankers and intelligence platforms.
